scope: Local model inference through MLX; isolated experiment, not a production OCR or PDF placement run.

method.mineru_sampling: MinerUClient two_step_extract defaults, no caller override; default crop batches of up to eight. Token truncation is not independently measured for this library.
method.memory: MLX peak allocations and process peak RSS are distinct views of unified memory, not additive.

manual_table_reference.method: Manually read from the exact PNGs. Data cells only, in physical row/column order. Historical decimal apostrophes are decimal points; commas separate thousands. A printed dash is retained as a missing-value cell.

controlled_chinese_reference:
中文与英文混排 OCR 受控测试

社会学研究不应把两个模型的识别结果一致，误认为它们都正确。判断文本是否完整，必须回到原始页面，检查正文、脚注、页码和表格。

例如，研究者在讨论行动与结构的关系时，需要区分个人的意图、实践中的约束，以及制度形成的历史条件。一个术语的遗漏，可能改变整段论证的含义。

本页用于受控测试，文字由程序生成；它不是历史扫描件，也不能证明模型在模糊图像、繁体中文、竖排古籍或手写资料上的准确率。

数字与符号：2026年10月9日；样本量 n = 128；识别时间 2.35 秒；价格 £19.99；温度 25°C；显著性水平 p < 0.05。

中英文混排：agency（能动性）、structure（结构）、reflexivity（反思性）、Pierre Bourdieu（皮埃尔·布迪厄）、Anthony Giddens（安东尼·吉登斯）。

脚注：所有速度数据均应注明硬件、推理后端、模型版本、输入分辨率，以及是否包含模型加载时间。小样本结果只能作为进一步测试的依据。

summary.quality_method: Best-span alphanumeric, NFKC/casefold CER on three manually transcribed body pages. Ignores case, spaces, punctuation, header/footer, two named captions, image descriptions in grounding, and two visually ambiguous plate-reference glyphs (11/II) in Salomons p86. Not a whole-page accuracy or layout score.

mineru-plain.sampling: MinerUClient defaults; no caller sampling overrides

execution_status.recovery: Explicitly loaded checkpoint chat_template.jinja after the first setup failed before inference.

manual_visual_checks.finding: Two body paragraph boxes approximately match the scan; title/page number/footer separate.
Rotated caption and page-reference boxes approximately match the scan. All three LightOnOCR-3 grounding variants retain the printed caption and 131.

Chapter-level destination page numbers 1, 12 and 28 omitted; plain also omits List of Figures destination xx. Grounding leaf entries include destination numbers in text but their boxes omit the right-hand destination column.
For example the box for 1.2. The Art Object 5 is [70,287,304,309], also omitting the right-hand destination column. This is not acceptable paragraph placement proof.
The printed plate reference glyphs are ambiguous as 11/II; those two glyphs are masked for all engines and for the reference. Original transcription and outputs retained.
Two 混排 become 混合 and 布迪厄 becomes 布迪尼; three alphanumeric substitutions.

limits: Eight historical scan pages and four stress samples, not a representative dataset or whole-book acceptance.
Controlled Chinese is generated high-contrast horizontal type, not a real scan.
Alphanumeric body CER ignores punctuation, spacing, case and content outside the aligned body span. Table check covers values and row/column order, not every label or merged-cell semantic.
Coordinate validity is not source correspondence; bounded box parsing passes despite visually incorrect text-to-box assignments.
LightOnOCR-3 grounding timed once per historical page; performance variance and a confidence interval are not established.
Sequential MLX on a plugged-in Mac; no vLLM/CUDA server, batching benchmark, quantization, thermal telemetry or PDF layout/translation acceptance.
MinerU first/second/third repetition means vary; small plain-mode differences must not be treated as a demonstrated large speedup.
